text:
maria: Seeing a p99 spike on hosted /v1/generate for the last 6m, baseline p99 ~220ms -> 1.8s. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/hosted/p99?range=6m :eyes:
ops-bot: alert: HOSTED_API_P99 > 1.5s for 5m on us-west-2 (route=/v1/generate)
li: rolling CPU/GPU profile attached, looks like kernel-selector churn + KV cache eviction hot loop. quick flame: https://perf.redwood.ai/flame/3321112222
hugo: any noisy tenants? I see queue depth on the route increased from 2 -> 12 around spike time.
maria: tenant-32 had a burst of long-context requests (seq=2048) around 3321111000. They were hitting quantized model variants.
alex: kernel selector logs show repeated fallback from fast-8bit-k to aux-float-k at 3321110987..3321111105. suspect mismatch for long contexts -> recompile miss?
li: profile snippet (cpu stacks) pasted below:
```
# top stacks (samples)
kernel_selector::choose() +0x34
runtime::execute_attention() +0x1a2
kv_cache::evict_range() +0x6f
runtime::dispatch_batch() +0x90
```
li: KV cache eviction rate jumped 8x, causing batching to fragment and queue depth to rise.
emma-sre: can we isolate tenant-32 and force small-request routing? propose temp policy: route seq>1024 -> dedicated-aux-pool and limit tenant concurrency.
hugo: agree. also recommend enabling kernel selector debug to get input shape histogram. we need to know why selector picked aux-float-k intermittently.
maria: I can push a quick policy change: set per-tenant rate-limit to 8 concurrent, route large contexts to aux-pool with reserved kernels. Will apply in 2m if no objections.
alex: do that. also, add a runtime flag to prefer fast-8bit-k unless memory pressure > 70% (temporary heuristic).
li: before change, quick probe command to gather in-flight batches:
```
# probe in-flight batches
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.local/_internal/routing/inflight?route=/v1/generate | jq .
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026.03.18-rc5 started on us-west-2 (deploy id d-7782)
emma-sre: note: rc5 includes kernel-selector adjustments from last week. rollback may be needed if behavior links to that deploy.
maria: policy change applied: tenant-32 concurrency=8, large-context routing enabled -> aux-pool.
(2m pass)
li: immediate reduction in queue depth on the route: p95 stable, p99 trending down to 320ms. KV eviction rate dropped ~70%.
hugo: logs show kernel-selector fallbacks stopped after route change. still want the selector histogram though.
alex: schedule a perf job to replay tenant-32 workload against fast-8bit-k with long context to reproduce; if fails, we may need kernel patch.
li: created replay job id replay-332111-1, running now.
(10m later)
li: replay shows deterministic vectorized memory spill in fast-8bit-k at seq>1536 leading to recompile + fallback. root cause: kernel assumes max kv-slot contiguous allocation; our allocator fragmented under heavy eviction.
emma-sre: action items: 1) short-term: keep tenant-32 on aux-pool + concurrency limit (applied) 2) mid-term: patch allocator to prefer contiguous kv slot allocation under long-context profiles 3) add telemetry: selector input-shape histograms + eviction counters to ALERTS.
maria: created ticket PERF-6123 with repro and profile links. assigning to eng-runtime/allocator and eng-runtime/kselector.
hugo: also put a canary to revert rc5 if any other tenants surface similar spikes.
alex: nice triage, leaving notes in runbook and adding a postmortem stub. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident resolved: HOSTED_API_P99 back under threshold at 3321112550
